test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In an election between two candidates, one candidate got 38% of the votes and yet lost by 7200 votes. If all the votes polled were valid, then the total number of votes cast in the election was:
solution:
**Given:**

Votes secured by one candidate = 38%

Difference in votes = 7200

**Formula Used:**

Total Votes = (Difference in votes) / (Percentage difference / 100)

**Calculation:**

Let total votes be V.

Votes secured by the other candidate = 62% of V (since total percentage is 100%)

Difference in votes = (62% of V) - (38% of V)

7200 = 62% of V - 38% of V

7200 = 24% of V

7200 = 24/100 × V

⇒ V = (7200 × 100) / 24

⇒ V = 720000 / 24

⇒ V = 30000

**The total number of votes cast in the election was 30000.**
